logline: As Rupert and Catherine issue wedding invitations paired with Juliana's public execution decree to terrorize the county, Juliana endures starvation in the dungeon, refusing to break her spirit.

moments.description: Catherine gloats over the wedding invitations and drops the shocking news that Juliana's public execution will follow.
moments.key_dialogue: Juliana's execution comes after the wedding.

moments.description: Lady Clarissa's husband discovers the horrific execution decree attached to the wedding invitation.
moments.key_dialogue: They want the families to witness it.

moments.description: Lady Clarissa delivers a contemptuous decree against women who try to rise above their station.
moments.key_dialogue: Juliana's ruin will be a lesson. And we will be there to watch.

moments.description: Starving in the dungeon, Juliana defiantly refuses the foul sustenance and vows not to surrender.
moments.key_dialogue: They think fear will make me beg.

moments.description: Juliana drags herself up from the wet stone floor in chains, proclaiming her indomitable spirit.
moments.key_dialogue: They cannot take who I am!

moments.description: Lady Clarissa relishes the impending public execution over wine as an ominous cello rumble builds to a tense close.
moments.key_dialogue: Let them see what happens when a woman forgets her place.
